subject.title: [Workspace panel] Root path drops leading dot, false 'Missing' labels on existing folders, broken layout

question: Should session workspace listings ever expose existence or metadata for transcript-mentioned paths outside the fs-safe workspace boundary?
rationale: The remaining false Missing behavior may involve symlink or external-path metadata, and automation cannot choose the product/security boundary for what the workspace panel may reveal.

options.title: Keep Metadata Inside Fs-Safe
options.body: External or fs-safe-rejected paths stay hidden or neutral, and the issue is fixed by filtering, clearer labels, or contained directory semantics only.

options.title: Expose External Metadata Deliberately
options.body: The gateway may report existence or metadata for transcript-mentioned external paths, but this needs explicit tests, documentation, and security acceptance before merge.

recommendation.title: Keep Metadata Inside Fs-Safe
recommendation.body: External or fs-safe-rejected paths stay hidden or neutral, and the issue is fixed by filtering, clearer labels, or contained directory semantics only.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent workspace browsing and fs-safe helper work makes this the strongest available owner for the boundary choice.
